fields.title: Probability distribution column
fields.description: Select the column containing the nominal probability distribution.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove selected column
fields.description: If selected, the selected column will be removed from the output.

fields.title: Suffix for probability columns
fields.description:
Specify a suffix for the probability columns. By default, no suffix is defined and the columns are named
by their class names.

fields.title: Missing value handling
fields.description: Specify how to treat a missing value in the input column. If Fail is selected, the node will fail. Otherwise, the node just gives a warning and puts missing values in the output for the corresponding rows.
